scope.descriptor_mass_column: 4 (fifth standard descriptor, ExactMolWt per descriptors README)
scope.method: For each ordinally corresponding amino.csv/std_amino.csv row, parse the supplied dataset SMILES with RDKit, canonicalize with Chem.MolToSmiles(canonical=True), read supplied feature mass from descriptor column 4, recompute Descriptors.ExactMolWt, calculate recomputed-minus-supplied delta, and read Chem.GetFormalCharge. Only abs(delta)>0.001 Da is listed. No protonation, pH, salt, or label repair was applied or inferred as fact. RDKit from .venv; script: .venv/bin/python - <<'PY' (csv.DictReader; rdkit.Chem; rdkit.Chem.Descriptors; see method above).

normalization_notes.issue: Names say hydrochloride, but disclosed SMILES have formal charge 0 and omit a chloride component; do not add Cl or alter labels without source evidence.

Name says chloride; disclosed SMILES contain an explicit +1 pyrrolidinium but no chloride component. Supplied descriptor mass is ~1 H below the disclosed SMILES exact mass and also does not include chloride.

Many dataset/descriptor name differences are capitalization only (casefold-equivalent); row 78 also differs only R/r stereodescriptor capitalization. Name matching should be case-insensitive, while preserving source labels and row IDs.
